newsitem.title: USA: Youth Services president Felton retires.
newsitem.headline: Youth Services president Felton retires.

text.p: Youth Services International Inc said Monday that its president, Henry Felton, retired, effective immediately, to pursue other interests.
Felton will remain a member of the board of directors.
Timothy Cole, the chief executive, will assume the president's duties, the company said.
Cole said the company and Felton had planned for his retirement, and that Chairman W. James Hindman would be less active in day-to-day operations after Cole became chief executive in August.
Youth Services provides residential treatment for troubled youths.
